description: Alterations to roof; rear dormer; rooflights in front and side roof slopes; external alterations; conversion of dwelling to three flats (3 x 2 beds); outbuilding at rear for use as storage
decision_conditions: <p style="text-align: justify; ">The proposed development, by reasons of the inadequate combined living/kitchen/dining GIA in Units A and B and the lack of private outdoor amenity spaces for both flats, would cumulatively result in sub-standard level of living accommodation for the future occupiers of the proposed dwellings, contrary to Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021), Policies GR1Cb and HO2(2)e and Strategic Policy 03 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041), Housing Design Standards London Plan Guidance (2023) and Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).</p>

<p style="text-align: justify; ">The application fails to provide any information
to demonstrate how the proposed development would achieve the statutory minimum
10%&nbsp;Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG), as required by the
Environment Act 2021. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning
Authority cannot be satisfied that the development would not result in a net
loss of biodiversity or that it would deliver the required net gain. The
proposal is therefore contrary to Policies G6 of the London Plan (2021), GI3
and Strategic Policy 07 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed
development, by reasons of the proposed housing mix, in particular, the lack of a three (3) bed unit, its location with poor
access to public transport and the substandard quality of accommodation to be
provided, would not be fit for purpose to the detriment of future occupiers. The proposed
development would therefore fail to achieve an appropriate housing mix, having
regard to the location of the site and its surroundings as well as the evidence
of local need which identifies a need for larger family sized units and would therefore fail to contribute to the creation of inclusive and mixed communities, contrary
to the provisions of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policies H1
and H10 of the London Plan (2021) and policies HO1A and B and HO2 of the Harrow
Local Plan (2021-2041).</span><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
